content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The traditional way of receiving payments through platforms like Stripe and PayPal is no longer viable for creators in restricted countries. These platforms often impose steep fees, restrictive terms, and delayed settlements, all of which can lead to frustrated customers and lost revenue. In contrast, setting up NOWPayments webhooks with Cloudflare Workers provides a decentralized payment solution that allows you to bypass these limitations and receive crypto payments directly to your wallet. This means faster settlements, lower fees, and greater control over your transactions.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you deploy this infrastructure, you'll need a few essential components: a Cloudflare account, a GitHub account for hosting your workers, and a NOWPayments account for receiving payments. You'll also need to configure your Cloudflare Pages and Workers settings to integrate with NOWPayments. Additionally, ensure you have a solid understanding of cloud computing, API integrations, and payment processing to successfully implement this solution.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

The payment and delivery pipeline is the backbone of your NOWPayments and Cloudflare Workers setup. You'll need to create a new Cloudflare Worker that listens for incoming payment notifications from NOWPayments and triggers the delivery of your digital product. This can be done using Cloudflare's built-in Workers feature, which allows you to write and deploy code directly to the edge of the network. By doing so, you can automate the delivery of your digital product to customers as soon as payment is confirmed.
With NOWPayments webhooks and Cloudflare Workers, you can receive crypto payments instantly and automate the delivery of your digital products to customers worldwide.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your payment and delivery pipeline is set up, it's time to go live and process your first transaction. This involves deploying your worker to Cloudflare, configuring your NOWPayments account to trigger payments, and testing your delivery pipeline to ensure seamless customer experiences. With this infrastructure in place, you can start receiving crypto payments instantly and automating the delivery of your digital products to customers worldwide.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

The transaction log in a COREMERCH deployment provides a complete, independently verifiable audit trail of every payment. Each entry includes the transaction hash, which links directly to the public blockchain record. You can verify any transaction independently on Tronscan, Etherscan, Solscan, or the relevant blockchain explorer — no platform intermediary required. If a buyer claims they paid but the transaction does not appear in your order log, you check the blockchain directly. This level of cryptographic verifiability is structurally impossible with conventional payment processors.
How do I receive crypto payments for my digital products?

The most common question we receive is, 'How do I receive crypto payments for my digital products?' The answer is simple: set up NOWPayments webhooks with Cloudflare Workers. This decentralized payment solution allows you to receive crypto payments directly to your wallet, bypassing traditional payment platforms like Stripe and PayPal. With this infrastructure, you can automate the delivery of your digital products to customers worldwide, ensuring seamless customer experiences and fast, reliable transactions.
You can use NOWPayments webhooks with Cloudflare Workers to receive payments in over 300 cryptocurrencies, including Bitcoin, Ethereum, and USDT.

Your Deployment Checklist

To set up NOWPayments webhooks with Cloudflare Workers, follow these concrete steps: Create a new Cloudflare Worker and configure it to listen for incoming payment notifications from NOWPayments. Set up your NOWPayments account to trigger payments and configure your delivery pipeline to automate the delivery of your digital product. Deploy your worker to Cloudflare and test your delivery pipeline to ensure seamless customer experiences. With these steps, you'll be able to set up a fast, reliable, and secure payment and delivery pipeline for your digital business.
